Global Configuration

The app.json file in the root directory of the Mini Program is used to configure the Mini Program globally. The file content is a JSON object with the following attributes:

Configuration Item

Properties Type Mini Program types are currently supported Mandatory or Not Default Value Description
entryPagePath String DSL/H5 No If this parameter is left blank, the first item in the pages list is used by default. Homepage of the Mini Program by default.This is a required field in the H5 applet.
embeddingType String DSL/H5 No Mini Program embedding type. The shell value of the DSL Mini Program is DSLEmbed, and the shell value of H5 is H5Embed (the minimum version is 24.12.0).
videoAutoPlay Boolean H5 No false Indicates whether to play automatically,the default value is false (Currently, only H5 is supported.Minimum version 24.9.0)
pages Array DSL/H5 Yes Page Path List
window Object DSL/H5 No For details, see the following description. Default Window Performance for Global
tabBar Object DSL No For details, see the following description. Performance of the bottom tab
subPackages Array DSL No For details, see the following description. Subcontracting structure configuration
usingComponents Object DSL No For details, see the following description. Global Custom Component Configuration,if there is subcontracting, the referenced content must be in the main package.
restartStrategy String DSL/H5 No homePage Restart Policy
ignoreSafeArea Boolean DSL/H5 No false Whether to ignore the safe area of the Mini Program, the default value is false(Currently only supports IOS)
capsuleShow Boolean DSL/H5 No true Indicates whether to display capsules. The default value is true(the minimum version is 24.12.0).
exitMode String DSL/H5 No exitMiniProgram Mini Program exit configuration policy. The default value is exitMiniProgram (the minimum version is 24.12.0).
hideStatusBar Boolean DSL/H5 No false Whether to hide the top status bar in full screen mode. The default value is false (the minimum version is 25.6.0).
enablePerformance Boolean DSL/H5 No false Whether to display the performance panel. The default value is false (the minimum version is 25.6.0).

enablePerformance (minimum version: 25.6.0)

Mini Program-level switch configuration. When enablePerformance is set to true, the performance panel is displayed.

{
   "enablePerformance": true
}

hideStatusBar (minimum version: 25.6.0)

Mini Program-level switch configuration. The status bar on the top is hidden when the Mini Program is in full screen and hideStatusBar is set to true.

Note:

  1. The status bar hiding configuration takes effect only when the navigation bar is set to custom.
  2. The iOS bang screen or home button display needs to be adapted by the Mini Program developer.
  3. The status bar is hidden only for the Mini Program page. The status bar is not hidden for the capsule menu items provided by the SDK, such as the settings page and Mini Program details page.
{
   "hideStatusBar": true
}

exitMode

Mini Program exit configuration policy. Valid values are backGroundRunningMiniProgram and exitMiniProgram.

entryPagePath

Specifies the default startup path (homepage) of the mini-program. In DSL mini programs, if not filled in, it will default to the first item in the pages list. This is a required field in H5 mini programs.

Note: The page path parameter is not supported.

   "pages":[
        "index.html"
    ],
    "entryPagePath": "index.html", 
    "videoAutoPlay": true,
    "page": {},

pages

This parameter specifies the pages that the Mini Program consists of. Each item corresponds to the path (including the file name) of a page. The file name does not need to be suffixed. The framework automatically searches for the four .json, .js, .maml, .mass files in the corresponding position for processing.

The pages array needs to be modified when pages are added or reduced in the Mini Program.
For example, the development directory is as follows:

├── app.js
├── app.json
├── app.mass
├── pages
│   │── index
│   │   ├── index.maml
│   │   ├── index.js
│   │   ├── index.json
│   │   └── index.mass
│   └── logs
│       ├── logs.maml
│       └── logs.js
└── utils

You need to write it in app.json.

{
  "pages": [
    "pages/index/index",
    "pages/logs/logs"
  ]
}

window

Used to set the status bar, navigation bar, and title background color of the Mini Program.

Properties Type Default Value Description
navigationBarBackgroundColor HexColor #000000 Background color of the navigation bar, for example, #000000
navigationBarTextStyle String white Title color of the navigation bar. Only black and white are supported.
navigationBarTitleText String Text content of the navigation bar title
navigationStyle String default Navigation bar style supports the following values: default, left, center,custom. For the custom navigation bar, only the capsule button at the top right corner is retained.When set to "left", the mini-program displays the title bar with the title aligned to the left.When set to "center", the mini-program displays the title bar with the title centered.For the "default" option, the title bar is displayed on both iOS and Android: the title is centered on iOS and aligned to the left on Android.（**25.12.0 change，addleft、center**）
showHomeButton Boolean true Whether to display the Home icon
enablePullDownRefresh Boolean false Whether to enable global pull-to-refresh.
onReachBottomDistance Number 50 Distance from the bottom of the page when the pull-up event is triggered. The unit is pixel.
backgroundTextStyle String light Drop-down background font style, legal values are light, dark (currently only supports IOS)
capsuleTheme String light Capsule style, legal values are light, dark
disableScreenRecord Boolean false Whether to forbid screen recording（This parameter is valid only for H5 Mini Program）,Android can disable screenshots
allowsInlineMediaPlayback Boolean true On IOS, the full-screen playback field is not enabled by default. Setting it to false will automatically enable full-screen playback, which only takes effect on H5.（**25.9.0 Change,The default value has been changed from false to true.**）
pageOrientation String landscape Landscape games are supported. The default value is landscape.By default, the screen is displayed in portrait mode. The screen is displayed in landscape mode only when landscape is configured. (the minimum version is 25.3.0).
safeAreaBackgroundColor HexColor #ffffff Background color of the safe area, for example, #ffffff (the minimum version is 26.3.0, only supports IOS)。
allowGestueNavigate Boolean true Allows users to swipe navigate to the previous or next page through gesture. This is enabled by default, but you can set it to false to disable this function globally(the minimum version is 26.3.0, only supports IOS).

Note: HexColor specifies a hexadecimal color value, for example, #ff00ff.

Note:

  1. When the navigationStyle is set to custom, the settings for navigationBarTitleText and showHomeButton do not take effect.
  2. When the navigationStyle is set to default, both navigationBarTitleText and showHomeButton take effect: setting it to true displays the small house icon, and setting it to false displays the back arrow (←).
  3. Default behavior: The back button/home icon controlled by showHomeButton does not display on the initial page; it only appears in the navigation bar after a page transition (entering a secondary page).
pageOrientation (minimum version: 25.3.0)

Enable the screen rotation support on your phone. The global configuration takes effect only for the cover Mini Program. "pageOrientation": landscapeIf this parameter is set to landscape, the Mini Program is displayed in portrait mode. Otherwise, the Mini Program is displayed in portrait mode. If pageOrientation is configured, the screen is forcibly displayed in landscape mode.

Sample Code
{
"pages": ["pages/index/index"],
"window": {
"pageOrientation": "landscape"
}
}

tabBar

If a Mini Program contains multiple tabs (a tab bar at the bottom or top of the client window can be used to switch between tabs), you can set the tabBar configuration items to specify the tab bar and the corresponding page to be displayed when the tab is switched.

Attribute Type Mandatory or Not Default Value Description
color HexColor Yes Default color of the text on the tab. Only the hexadecimal color code is supported.
selectedColor HexColor Yes Color of the selected text on the tab. Only the hexadecimal color code is supported.
list Array Yes List of tabs. For details, see the list attribute description. Only two to five tabs are supported.

Only one array is supported in the list, that is, only two to five tabs can be configured. Tabs are sorted in the order of the array. Each item is an object. The attribute values are as follows.

Attribute Type Mandatory or Not Description
pagePath String Yes Page path, which must be defined in pages.
text String Yes Button text on the tab.
iconPath String No Icon path. The maximum size of an icon is 40 KB. The recommended size is 81 px x 81 px. Network images are not supported.
selectedIconPath String No Selected icon path. The maximum size of an icon is 40 KB. The recommended size is 81 px x 81 px. Network images are not supported.

subpackages

Declares the project subcontracting structure when subcontracting loading is enabled.

usingComponents

Custom components declared in app.json are considered global custom components and can be directly used in pages or custom components in Mini Programs without being declared.

Note: Globally declared custom components are considered dependent on all pages, are initialized when all pages are started, and occupy the main package size. Customized components that are referenced only by individual pages or packages should be declared in the page configuration.

Mini Program Cold Start Page(Minimum version: 24.9.0)

During the cold startup of the Mini Program, the following pages are displayed:

(Class-A scenario) If the path is not carried in the startup scenario

(Class-B scenario) If the startup scenario contains a path, the page corresponding to the path is displayed.

Restart Policy

During cold startup of a Mini Program, if the startup does not contain path (class-A scenario), the home page of the Mini Program is displayed by default. In the JSON file corresponding to the page (or globally configured in the In the window section of app.json), specify the restartStrategy configuration item to change the default behavior so that after exiting from a page, the next time A You can return to this page for a cold start of a class scenario.

Sample Code
{
   "restartStrategy": "homePage"
}
restartStrategy Optional Values Meanings
homePage (Default) If you exit the Mini Program from this page, next time it will cold boot from the home page
homePageAndLatestPage If you exit the Mini Program from this page, the page is loaded immediately after the next cold start, and the page parameters remain unchanged (not applicable to tab pages).

Note: Even if it is not configured as'homePage', if the Mini Program exits for too long , the next cold start will not follow the'restartStrategy' configuration, but directly from the home page cold start.

In any case, the status on the page is not retained. For example, the text content in the input box and the check box status are not restored.

ignoreSafeArea (minimum version: 24.3.0)

In the original Mini Program scenario, the webview component of the Mini Program does not occupy the safe area at the bottom. At this time, the background of the horizontal bar at the bottom of the page is the system color.

After enabling this configuration item, the Mini Program's webview will ignore the safe area restrictions at the bottom, and the bottom horizontal bar will become a transparent background

Tips

  1. The current configuration item is only effective on IOS models, it is not required, and the default value is false

  2. This configuration item follows the principle of the smaller the granularity, the higher the priority. The minimum supported granularity is Mini Program global configuration, and the priority is

    Mini Program Global Configuration > Host APP Configuration

Q&A

  1. Q: The interactive component with position: fixed is rendered outside the safe area of iPhone X and later models. It is easy to accidentally touch the Home Indicator, resulting in misoperation. How to solve it?

    A: For such scenarios, you can try to set the distance between the safe area and the boundary in mass to prevent accidental touches. For details, please refer to the following sample code：

padding-bottom: constant(safe-area-inset-bottom); /* IOS < 11.2 */
padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom);      /* IOS >= 11.2 */
